retention_notes: Raw request traces, all outliers, logs, build/test commands, frozen identities and host monitoring are retained locally.

Development tool-output excerpts are preserved in development-evidence.json; early full CTest logs were superseded, as explicitly recorded there.
Baseline and immediate-sync external builds are reused from the previous experiment with hashes verified; prototype builds/wheels are isolated and non-editable.
